blocks.code:
import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'
import { bindStoreMiddleware, loggerMiddleware } from '@migaia/store-middleware'

const events: string[] = []
const store = createStore({ count: 0 })
const execution = { mutationTimeoutMs: false, pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: false } as const
const host = bindStoreMiddleware(store, { execution })
await host.use(loggerMiddleware((event) => events.push(event.type)))
store.count = 1
store.$runtime.flush()
console.log(events.join(','))
await host.dispose()
store.count = 2
console.log(store.count)
await store.$dispose()

blocks.text: 本包为 Store 提供写入许可、action/state/error 事件和可装卸诊断插件；状态字段、订阅、$plain/$hydrate 属于 store-light，依赖图与上报属于 reactive，安装/卸载和 pipeline 属于 plugin-host。它不实现持久化或历史面板，相关功能分别由 store-persist、store-devtools 组合。只要简单监听状态时，Store.$subscribe 已足够。

根入口导出 MutationPolicy/createMutationPolicy、事件与命令词表、Host/binding/logger/DevTools adapter 和错误；克隆策略只从 `@migaia/store-middleware/tolerant-clone` 导入。普通依赖为 middleware-pipeline、plugin-host、reactive、store-light、utils。示例直接导入 store-light/reactive 时要显式安装对应包。

旧 middlewarePlugin/IStoreMiddleware/IMiddlewareContext 已移除，改用 `IStoreMiddlewarePlugin` 的 install(core) 与 core.usePipeline。旧 tolerantClone 名在两入口都已删除；ClonePolicy、immutableSnapshotClone、opaqueReferenceClone、diagnosticClone 以及 IClonePolicyMode 都归窄入口。IMutationGuard/IMutationPolicy 直接从 store-light 导入，没有本包别名。原 store-devtools 的 StoreDevtoolsCommand/IStoreDevtoolsCommand 迁移到本包 ReduxDevToolsCommand/IReduxDevToolsCommand，协议字符串不变。

`new MutationPolicy(mode?)` 与 `createMutationPolicy(mode?)` 等价，mode 默认 `'off'`，联合为 `'off' | 'actions-only'`。off 放行；actions-only 在当前 action 深度为 0 时拒绝 assertMutationAllowed，错误为 ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED，信息为 `[store] {operation} is not allowed outside an action`。

blocks.text: 返回 Promise 不延长作用域，不等待其结算；await 后写入要重新进入 action。它不是事务，不回滚已完成写入或回调的外部副作用。同步 fn 失败保留已有包身份，未编码失败按 CALLBACK_FAILED 附码或通过 cause/errors 保留原值。
要让 host.runAction 授权 Store 写入，createStore 和 binding 必须共享同一个 mutationPolicy。不同实例不会取消 Store 自己的直接写守卫；Store action、$set/$batch 等仍进入其自身策略，但 Host 不能授权另一个实例。策略放行与真正拦截字段写入是两回事，后者由 Store 负责。

blocks.text: runAction 不等待返回 Promise；同步返回即发 end，后续 rejection 不会自动变成这次 action:error。它本身不克隆状态或撤销失败 action 之前的写入。recordState/recordError 和 runAction 的观察事件通过隔离通道报告诊断失败；公开 emit 不在该隔离保证内。

`IStoreMiddlewarePlugin<S,TExt,TConfig,TShared>` 直接复用通用 IPlugin；后三个类型默认分别为 Record<string,never>、Record<string,unknown>、Record<string,never>。install(core) 同时拿到通用 config/getShared/onDispose/usePipeline 和领域 runtime/getState()/applyState(state)/reportError(error,phase)。领域错误上报透传 Runtime。

只能 usePipeline 注册同步 stage；useAsyncPipeline/useGeneratorPipeline 模式不匹配，由 plugin-host 的 PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH 拒绝。next(event) 只记录继续值，下游在当前 stage 返回后执行；不能用 next 后的代码同步观察下游完成。只第一次 next 生效，重复/迟到按 PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE/PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE 报告。遗漏 next 阻止后续事件处理并向 Runtime trace-listener 报 MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED，不撤销已经发生的 Store 写入。

`loggerMiddleware<S=any>(sink?)` 创建名称固定 `'store-logger'` 的插件。sink 默认 `console.log('[store]',event,state)`，参数为 `(IMiddlewareEvent<unknown>,unknown)=>void`；不依赖状态类型，S 仅用于约束目标 Host。它先调用 next 记录继续值，再在当前 stage 读取 core.getState 并调用 sink；此时下游 stage 还未运行。state 是调用 sink 时读到的值，不是事件生成时自动固定的快照。sink 的返回 Promise 不被等待。

blocks.text: 绑定时把 clone(store.$plain()) 记为 previous；首次同步读取/clone 失败复用 callback 身份规则，未编码失败归 CALLBACK_FAILED，可附码原生错误保持原实例，冻结错误经 cause 保留；后续订阅与 Host 读取仍沿各自 owner 的错误路径处理。之后每次 Store 通知重新复制为 next，调用 recordState('store:update',previous,next)，再更新 previous。绑定前的历史不会回放，第一份 previous 是绑定当时的值。getState 每次重新 clone($plain)，applyState 桥接 $hydrate。

只桥接 $plain 暴露的普通字段；computed、方法、WASM 支撑字段及外部资源不进入 previous/next。Runtime action trace 直接 host.emit 转发，不再 host.runAction，因此不重复进入策略；不要再手动用 host.runAction 包装同一个 Store action，否则两条路径各自发事件。actionPrefix 过滤的是同一 Runtime 的 trace 名称，不是 Store 所有权鉴别。
订阅构造失败时先尝试退订 trace 与状态，再关闭 Host；若同步回滚也失败，用 CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError，errors[0] 为主错，其后保留原清理错误。清理失败没有抹掉原始绑定失败。成功绑定的正常 dispose 走结构化结果，不沿此异常路径。

`IDevToolsAdapter<S>` 有同步 init(state:S)、send(event:IMiddlewareEvent<S>,state:S)，可选 subscribe(listener:(command:IDevToolsCommand<S>)=>void):IDisposer。init/send 必须为函数，subscribe 若存在也必须为函数，否则 connectDevTools 拒绝 INVALID_OPTION。

领域命令为 `{type:'commit'} | {type:'jump',state:S} | {type:'reset',state:S}`。连接时立即 init(core.getState())；每事件 stage 中 next 后调用 send，仍遵循“当前 stage 返回才到下游”。commit 重新 init 当前状态；jump/reset 用 runAction('devtools:<type>',()=>applyState(state)) 执行，会产生真正 action 事件。未提供 applyState 时 DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY；binding 已桥接 $hydrate。只恢复普通字段，不还原外部副作用、方法、computed 或 WASM 资源。

`createReduxDevToolsAdapter<S>(connection:IReduxDevToolsConnection<S>,runtime?)` 的 connection 必填且含 init(state)、send(action:unknown,state)、subscribe(listener):IDisposer；runtime 默认共享 Runtime，仅用于解析失败报告。IReduxDevToolsMessage 的 type、payload.type、state 都可省略，state 是 JSON 字符串。

rows: 独立深拷贝或拒绝，不静默返回共享子树；不等于 Object.freeze
原值原引用，不进行复制；明确接受共享

blocks.text: immutable 先接纳严格数据图，再委托 Utils 唯一 structuredClone 实现。允许普通/null 原型记录、普通数组、当前 realm 原生 Map/Set/Date/RegExp/ArrayBuffer，以及非共享 ArrayBuffer 支撑的标准 TypedArray/DataView。递归检查 Map key/value、Set 成员和记录/数组数据属性；循环与共享引用交由原克隆引擎保持。自定义 class（含内建子类）、未接纳的原生类型拒绝；记录/数组访问器在求值前拒绝，不运行 getter。函数、symbol 等由 canonical clone 拒绝。缺 structuredClone 为 ENV_UNSUPPORTED，不支持值为 CLONE_UNSUPPORTED；Utils 错误整个保留在 cause，其下再到原生失败，不跳过中间层。
旧版 class 静默丢方法、getter 求值、跨 realm 或未列内建值应迁移为支持的数据，或明确选择 diagnostic/opaque。Utils 自身的投影契约没有被本策略改写。

diagnostic 优先 structuredClone，失败时复用 canonical 递归复制：plain object/array 递归，支持的 Date/RegExp/Map/Set/ArrayBuffer/TypedArray 子树单独克隆，函数/类/宿主子树可保留引用。枚举访问器按 Utils 行为读取并记录，`__proto__` 通过 defineProperty 写入；循环和共享结构由该遍历处理，不另建 clone 引擎。默认 binding 的 diagnostic 不能保证全树隔离；opaque 只是省去复制，不承诺实测速度。
Host 的 use/unUse/dispose、插件失败回滚、配置与资源逆序清理归 plugin-host。同一 Host 插件名唯一。dispose 首先关闭 binding disposer 登记，再同步按后进先出调用，尝试全部清理，之后卸载插件；不等待 disposer 返回的 Promise，应登记同步函数。重入登记立即执行；晚登记失败按 callback 身份规则同步传播。

重复 dispose 返回同一 Promise，结果为 `{logicalTerminal,cleanupComplete,cleanupErrors}`，可保留 plugin-host 的其它物理清理信息。绑定 disposer 失败排在 cleanupErrors 前面，然后是插件清理失败；这些被收集而不以清理异常拒绝 Promise。cleanupComplete 沿用插件清理完成状态，表示物理完成，不表示 cleanupErrors 必为空。关闭不会销毁借入 Store/Runtime；Store 可继续工作，只是不再被这一绑定观察。领域闭包没有统一的 open 守卫，保留的 runAction 仍可执行 fn；关闭插件接纳不等于取消任意业务回调。

sections.heading: 观察 Store 并在解绑后继续使用

blocks.text: 诊断面板需要观察已有 Store 的动作与状态事件；关闭面板应停止观察，同时让应用状态继续可用。
把已经发出追踪事件的 Store 动作再包进一层动作，会增加重复边界；把绑定当作 Store 所有者，又会让面板清理销毁应用状态。
`bindStoreMiddleware` 转发 Store 自身的动作追踪与状态通知；直接安装 `@migaia/store-light`，用 `loggerMiddleware` 收集事件类型，刷新 Store 运行时后，独立释放绑定。
输出：

blocks.code:
2 true 1
0 2

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `2 true 1`、`0 2`；首次动作产生两条动作事件及状态事件，绑定释放后，另一次动作仍改变 Store，却不再进入原中间件。
执行预算必填，`false` 显式取消对应截止时间；绑定只借用 Store 和运行时，默认诊断克隆尽力复制，不支持的子树仍可能按引用共享。

createStore 的 shape 包含 count 字段与 increment 方法；未传自定义 mutationPolicy。binding 的 execution 两字段明确为 false，其余选项省略：Host 使用 off 策略，actionPrefix 为 undefined，clone 使用 diagnostic。loggerMiddleware 的 sink 收集 event.type；省略 sink 时输出到 console.log。Store 与 Runtime 只借入，最后由应用显式 $dispose Store。

sections.id: 让-store-与宿主共享同一严格策略
sections.heading: 让 Store 与宿主共享同一严格策略

blocks.text: 组件不能直接赋值，但 Store 方法与宿主管理的动作都需要修改同一状态。
分别创建两个 `actions-only` 策略会产生两套动作深度；进入宿主策略的作用域，不能替另一个 Store 策略授权写入。
创建一份 `actions-only` 策略，把同一对象交给 `createStore` 与 `bindStoreMiddleware`；直接安装 `@migaia/store-light`，由 Store 执行守卫，`host.runAction` 进入共享作用域。
输出：

blocks.code:
ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED
true 2
3

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED`、`true 2`、`3`；直接赋值被拒绝，宿主持有同一个策略且能在动作内写入，Store 自身动作仍可使用。
策略模式默认 `off`；它检查写入许可，不是事务，也不会撤销用户副作用，作用域只覆盖同步执行，`await` 后的写入须重新进入作用域。

createMutationPolicy 的 mode 默认为 off，本例明确 actions-only。Store options.mutationPolicy 与 binding options.mutationPolicy 是同一个对象；两 execution 预算为 false。runAction 的 name 是诊断名，fn 同步写入，metadata 省略为 undefined。Store action 进入自身作用域，直接字段写入先经过守卫。

sections.id: 区分诊断接收器失败与业务失败
sections.heading: 区分诊断接收器失败与业务失败

blocks.text: 日志接收器在观察动作时失败；应用仍须执行业务函数，而真正的业务异常必须交给调用者。
在业务路径上直接调用诊断接收器，会让日志故障中断动作；反过来吞掉所有异常，又会掩盖真实业务失败，还可能让人误以为状态已经回滚。
`createStoreMiddlewareHost` 隔离 `runAction` 的观察事件，并向传入运行时报告失败；直接安装 `@migaia/reactive`，本例用 `onError` 收集诊断，业务回调仍正常返回或抛错。
输出：

blocks.code:
42 1 2
true 2 4

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `42 1 2`、`true 2 4`；成功业务结果不受两次诊断报告影响，失败动作交付原业务错误，失败前的赋值仍已生效。
`runAction`、`recordState/recordError` 隔离观察失败，公开 `emit` 则可能抛出流水线错误；`runAction` 同步批处理，不回滚写入，也不等待返回的 Promise。

createRuntime.onError 接收诊断错误；省略时使用 Runtime adapter.reportError。Host runtime 与 getState 必填，getState 返回本例 state 引用，不自动克隆；applyState 省略，mutationPolicy 默认为 off。两 execution 为 false。logger sink 同步抛诊断错误；两个 runAction 分别返回值或抛本地原错。

sections.id: 逆序释放绑定并保留清理失败
sections.heading: 逆序释放绑定并保留清理失败

blocks.text: 面板拥有两项绑定清理和一个插件资源；其中一项绑定清理失败，另一项绑定与插件仍须释放。
遇到第一个清理异常就停止，会遗留后续资源；多个调用者各自启动释放，也可能重复执行同一清理。
把同步绑定清理交给 `createStoreMiddlewareHost.attachBindingDisposer`，插件清理通过 `core.onDispose` 登记；直接安装 `@migaia/reactive`，`host.dispose` 先逆序执行绑定清理，再委托插件清理。
输出：

blocks.code:
true
["二号","一号","插件"]
true 1 true

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `true`、`["二号","一号","插件"]`、`true 1 true`；释放调用共享同一个 Promise，清理按输出顺序继续执行，原始失败保留在 `cleanupErrors`。
`cleanupComplete` 表示委托清理已完成，不等于错误列表为空，已完成的绑定清理失败仍会记录；此处绑定清理函数是同步函数，不据此推断所有插件钩子都串行执行。

Host 传入 createRuntime() 与 getState，execution 均为 false。attachBindingDisposer 接受同步无参函数；后登记的先执行。插件的 name 在该 Host 内唯一，install(core) 用 core.onDispose 登记插件资源并返回空扩展。dispose 无参数，cleanupComplete 和 cleanupErrors 各自描述完成情况与失败。

sections.id: 在-await-后重新进入动作作用域
sections.heading: 在 await 后重新进入动作作用域

blocks.text: 异步流程从获准动作开始，等待下一步后再尝试受保护写入；后续执行不应继承已经返回的同步许可作用域。
一直把全局动作标记留到 Promise 完成，会让期间的无关工作也得到授权；把同步守卫当作异步事务，又会隐藏许可真正结束的位置。
`MutationPolicy.runInAction` 只在调用回调期间增加深度，并在 `finally` 恢复；比较返回前后的 `insideAction`，等待失败后，再显式进入一次同步写入作用域。
输出：

blocks.code:
true false
ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED false
已重新进入

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `true false`、`ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED false`、`已重新进入`；异步回调开始时在作用域内，`await` 后的执行被拒绝，显式重新进入后检查通过。
模式默认 `off`，本例选择 `actions-only`；`runInAction` 立即返回回调结果，支持同步嵌套，不等待也不自动捕获稍后的 Promise 拒绝。
MutationPolicy mode 明确为 actions-only，省略则 off。runInAction 的 fn 立即返回 Promise，后续 await 不保留同步作用域；assertMutationAllowed 的 operation 默认为 'mutation'，本例自定义字符串只作诊断。insideAction 是只读状态，不是可外部设置的授权开关。

sections.id: 明确选择独立副本或引用共享
sections.heading: 明确选择独立副本或引用共享

blocks.text: 审计历史需要独立的嵌套数据，诊断却可能需要保留无法克隆的回调；调用者必须明确选择需要哪种保证。
含糊的回退克隆可能在历史记录要求隔离时，悄悄返回实时引用；把结果称作不可变，还可能让人误以为返回对象已经冻结。
`ClonePolicy.immutable` 要求支持的数据图得到独立副本，`opaque` 返回原引用，`diagnostic` 尽力复制；严格路径在执行访问器 getter 前就拒绝该输入。
输出：

blocks.code:
1 2 false true
CLONE_UNSUPPORTED 0
1 true
false

blocks.text: 逐行输出 `1 2 false true`、`CLONE_UNSUPPORTED 0`、`1 true`、`false`；严格副本独立，不透明策略共享引用，getter 没被执行，诊断策略复制嵌套数据并保留回调身份。
独立不等于冻结；缺少 `structuredClone` 时严格策略可能抛 `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`，不支持的数据可能抛 `CLONE_UNSUPPORTED`，诊断策略仍可能共享不支持的子树，不透明策略始终返回原值。
三种策略均只接收 value，无 options；本例 source 为普通记录与嵌套数据。immutable 得到独立可变副本，opaque 保持严格引用身份；diagnostic 复制支持的嵌套数据并保留函数引用。Object.defineProperty 的 getter 被严格准入拒绝，reads=0；immutable 不是冻结函数。

本包为 Store 提供写入许可、action/state/error 事件和可装卸诊断插件；状态字段、订阅、$plain/$hydrate 属于 store-light，依赖图与上报属于 reactive，安装/卸载和 pipeline 属于 plugin-host。它不实现持久化或历史面板，相关功能分别由 store-persist、store-devtools 组合。只要简单监听状态时，Store.$subscribe 已足够。

根入口导出 MutationPolicy/createMutationPolicy、事件与命令词表、Host/binding/logger/DevTools adapter 和错误；克隆策略只从 `@migaia/store-middleware/tolerant-clone` 导入。普通依赖为 middleware-pipeline、plugin-host、reactive、store-light、utils。示例直接导入 store-light/reactive 时要显式安装对应包。

旧 middlewarePlugin/IStoreMiddleware/IMiddlewareContext 已移除，改用 `IStoreMiddlewarePlugin` 的 install(core) 与 core.usePipeline。旧 tolerantClone 名在两入口都已删除；ClonePolicy、immutableSnapshotClone、opaqueReferenceClone、diagnosticClone 以及 IClonePolicyMode 都归窄入口。IMutationGuard/IMutationPolicy 直接从 store-light 导入，没有本包别名。原 store-devtools 的 StoreDevtoolsCommand/IStoreDevtoolsCommand 迁移到本包 ReduxDevToolsCommand/IReduxDevToolsCommand，协议字符串不变。

`new MutationPolicy(mode?)` 与 `createMutationPolicy(mode?)` 等价，mode 默认 `'off'`，联合为 `'off' | 'actions-only'`。off 放行；actions-only 在当前 action 深度为 0 时拒绝 assertMutationAllowed，错误为 ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED，信息为 `[store] {operation} is not allowed outside an action`。

要让 host.runAction 授权 Store 写入，createStore 和 binding 必须共享同一个 mutationPolicy。不同实例不会取消 Store 自己的直接写守卫；Store action、$set/$batch 等仍进入其自身策略，但 Host 不能授权另一个实例。策略放行与真正拦截字段写入是两回事，后者由 Store 负责。

blocks.text: runAction 不等待返回 Promise；同步返回即发 end，后续 rejection 不会自动变成这次 action:error。它本身不克隆状态或撤销失败 action 之前的写入。recordState/recordError 和 runAction 的观察事件通过隔离通道报告诊断失败；公开 emit 不在该隔离保证内。

`IStoreMiddlewarePlugin<S,TExt,TConfig,TShared>` 直接复用通用 IPlugin；后三个类型默认分别为 Record<string,never>、Record<string,unknown>、Record<string,never>。install(core) 同时拿到通用 config/getShared/onDispose/usePipeline 和领域 runtime/getState()/applyState(state)/reportError(error,phase)。领域错误上报透传 Runtime。

只能 usePipeline 注册同步 stage；useAsyncPipeline/useGeneratorPipeline 模式不匹配，由 plugin-host 的 PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH 拒绝。next(event) 只记录继续值，下游在当前 stage 返回后执行；不能用 next 后的代码同步观察下游完成。只第一次 next 生效，重复/迟到按 PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE/PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE 报告。遗漏 next 阻止后续事件处理并向 Runtime trace-listener 报 MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED，不撤销已经发生的 Store 写入。

`loggerMiddleware<S=any>(sink?)` 创建名称固定 `'store-logger'` 的插件。sink 默认 `console.log('[store]',event,state)`，参数为 `(IMiddlewareEvent<unknown>,unknown)=>void`；不依赖状态类型，S 仅用于约束目标 Host。它先调用 next 记录继续值，再在当前 stage 读取 core.getState 并调用 sink；此时下游 stage 还未运行。state 是调用 sink 时读到的值，不是事件生成时自动固定的快照。sink 的返回 Promise 不被等待。

sections.heading: bindStoreMiddleware：借用 Store 并桥接观察

blocks.text: `bindStoreMiddleware<S extends Record<string,unknown>>(store:IReactiveStore<S>,options:IStoreMiddlewareBindingOptions):IStoreMiddlewareBinding<S>` 的两个参数均必填。返回同一个冻结 canonical Host，含只读 store 属性，严格等于传入实例；并非另建 Store 或 Runtime。

只转发 name 以此前缀开头的 action trace；空字符串不过滤
绑定、状态通知及 getState 每次尽力复制，可能共享不支持子树

blocks.text: 绑定时把 clone(store.$plain()) 记为 previous；首次同步读取/clone 失败复用 callback 身份规则，未编码失败归 CALLBACK_FAILED，可附码原生错误保持原实例，冻结错误经 cause 保留；后续订阅与 Host 读取仍沿各自 owner 的错误路径处理。之后每次 Store 通知重新复制为 next，调用 recordState('store:update',previous,next)，再更新 previous。绑定前的历史不会回放，第一份 previous 是绑定当时的值。getState 每次重新 clone($plain)，applyState 桥接 $hydrate。

只桥接 $plain 暴露的普通字段；computed、方法、WASM 支撑字段及外部资源不进入 previous/next。Runtime action trace 直接 host.emit 转发，不再 host.runAction，因此不重复进入策略；不要再手动用 host.runAction 包装同一个 Store action，否则两条路径各自发事件。actionPrefix 过滤的是同一 Runtime 的 trace 名称，不是 Store 所有权鉴别。
订阅构造失败时先尝试退订 trace 与状态，再关闭 Host；若同步回滚也失败，用 CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError，errors[0] 为主错，其后保留原清理错误。清理失败没有抹掉原始绑定失败。成功绑定的正常 dispose 走结构化结果，不沿此异常路径。

`IDevToolsAdapter<S>` 有同步 init(state:S)、send(event:IMiddlewareEvent<S>,state:S)，可选 subscribe(listener:(command:IDevToolsCommand<S>)=>void):IDisposer。init/send 必须为函数，subscribe 若存在也必须为函数，否则 connectDevTools 拒绝 INVALID_OPTION。

领域命令为 `{type:'commit'} | {type:'jump',state:S} | {type:'reset',state:S}`。连接时立即 init(core.getState())；每事件 stage 中 next 后调用 send，仍遵循“当前 stage 返回才到下游”。commit 重新 init 当前状态；jump/reset 用 runAction('devtools:<type>',()=>applyState(state)) 执行，会产生真正 action 事件。未提供 applyState 时 DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY；binding 已桥接 $hydrate。只恢复普通字段，不还原外部副作用、方法、computed 或 WASM 资源。

`createReduxDevToolsAdapter<S>(connection:IReduxDevToolsConnection<S>,runtime?)` 的 connection 必填且含 init(state)、send(action:unknown,state)、subscribe(listener):IDisposer；runtime 默认共享 Runtime，仅用于解析失败报告。IReduxDevToolsMessage 的 type、payload.type、state 都可省略，state 是 JSON 字符串。

blocks.text: This module adds mutation permission, action/state/error events, and removable diagnostic plugins to a Store. store-light owns fields, subscriptions, $plain/$hydrate; reactive owns the dependency graph and reporting; plugin-host owns installation, removal, and pipelines. Persistence and a history panel belong to store-persist and store-devtools. Store.$subscribe is enough for a simple state listener.

The root exports MutationPolicy/createMutationPolicy, event and command vocabularies, the Host/binding/logger/DevTools adapter, and errors. Clone strategies are available only from `@migaia/store-middleware/tolerant-clone`. Ordinary dependencies are middleware-pipeline, plugin-host, reactive, store-light, and utils. Explicitly install store-light/reactive when importing them directly in an example.

The old middlewarePlugin/IStoreMiddleware/IMiddlewareContext adapters were removed; use `IStoreMiddlewarePlugin`, install(core), and core.usePipeline. tolerantClone no longer exists at either entry. ClonePolicy, immutableSnapshotClone, opaqueReferenceClone, diagnosticClone, and IClonePolicyMode belong to the narrow entry. Import IMutationGuard/IMutationPolicy directly from store-light; this module has no aliases. The former store-devtools StoreDevtoolsCommand/IStoreDevtoolsCommand imports move to ReduxDevToolsCommand/IReduxDevToolsCommand here without changing protocol strings.

`new MutationPolicy(mode?)` and `createMutationPolicy(mode?)` are equivalent. mode defaults to `'off'` and is `'off' | 'actions-only'`. off allows writes; actions-only rejects assertMutationAllowed at action depth zero with ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED and `[store] {operation} is not allowed outside an action`.

Separate instances do not disable the Store's direct-write guard: Store actions and $set/$batch enter their own policy, but the Host cannot authorize a different instance. The Store owns actual field-write interception; the policy only grants permission.

blocks.text: runAction does not wait for a returned Promise: synchronous return emits end, and a later rejection does not automatically become action:error. It does not clone state or undo writes before an action failed. recordState/recordError and runAction observation events report diagnostic failures through an isolated path. Public emit is outside that isolation guarantee.

`IStoreMiddlewarePlugin<S,TExt,TConfig,TShared>` reuses IPlugin. The last three type parameters default to Record<string,never>, Record<string,unknown>, and Record<string,never>. install(core) receives general config/getShared/onDispose/usePipeline plus domain runtime/getState()/applyState(state)/reportError(error,phase). Domain error reporting delegates to the Runtime.

Register synchronous stages with usePipeline. useAsyncPipeline/useGeneratorPipeline is rejected by plugin-host with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH. next(event) only records the continuation value; downstream starts after the current stage returns. Code after next therefore cannot synchronously observe downstream completion. Only the first next takes effect; duplicate/late calls are reported as PIPELINE_NEXT_DUPLICATE/PIPELINE_NEXT_LATE. Omitting next filters the remaining event chain and reports MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED through the Runtime's trace-listener phase; it does not undo a Store write that already happened.

`loggerMiddleware<S=any>(sink?)` creates a plugin with fixed name `'store-logger'`. sink defaults to `console.log('[store]',event,state)` and has type `(IMiddlewareEvent<unknown>,unknown)=>void`. It does not depend on state shape; S can pin the target Host type. The stage calls next to record continuation, then reads core.getState and invokes sink before the downstream stage runs. state is read at sink invocation, not automatically captured when the event was created. Returned sink Promises are not awaited.

It returns the same frozen canonical Host with a readonly store property strictly equal to the supplied instance. It creates neither another Store nor another Runtime.

blocks.text: Binding captures clone(store.$plain()) as previous. A synchronous initial state-read/clone failure uses callback identity handling: uncoded failures become CALLBACK_FAILED, extensible native errors retain identity, and a frozen error remains on cause. Later subscription and Host reads keep their respective owner's error path. Each Store notification clones next, calls recordState('store:update',previous,next), then updates previous. Earlier history is not replayed: the first previous reflects binding time. Every getState clones $plain again, and applyState delegates to $hydrate.

Only ordinary fields exposed by $plain enter previous/next. Computed values, methods, WASM-backed fields, and external resources do not. Runtime action traces go straight to host.emit rather than host.runAction, avoiding a second policy scope. Wrapping the same bound Store action manually in host.runAction creates two independent event paths. actionPrefix filters names from the shared Runtime; it does not establish Store ownership.

If subscription construction fails, rollback attempts trace and state unsubscription before closing the Host. A synchronous rollback failure produces CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError with the primary error at errors[0], followed by original cleanup errors. Cleanup does not erase the initial binding failure. Normal disposal after successful binding uses a structured result instead of this exception path.

`IDevToolsAdapter<S>` provides synchronous init(state:S) and send(event:IMiddlewareEvent<S>,state:S), plus optional subscribe(listener:(command:IDevToolsCommand<S>)=>void):IDisposer. init/send must be functions, and a supplied subscribe must also be callable; otherwise connectDevTools rejects INVALID_OPTION.

Domain commands are `{type:'commit'} | {type:'jump',state:S} | {type:'reset',state:S}`. Connection immediately calls init(core.getState()). Its event stage calls next then send, still before downstream execution. commit reinitializes current state. jump/reset use runAction('devtools:<type>',()=>applyState(state)), creating real action events. Without applyState this is DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY; a binding already bridges $hydrate. Only ordinary fields are restored, not external effects, methods, computed values, or WASM resources.

`createReduxDevToolsAdapter<S>(connection:IReduxDevToolsConnection<S>,runtime?)` requires connection with init(state), send(action:unknown,state), and subscribe(listener):IDisposer. runtime defaults to the shared Runtime and reports parse failures. IReduxDevToolsMessage has optional type, payload.type, and state; state is a JSON string.

blocks.text: immutable admits a strict data graph, then delegates to Utils' sole structuredClone implementation. Supported values include ordinary/null-prototype records, ordinary arrays, current-realm native Map/Set/Date/RegExp/ArrayBuffer, and standard TypedArray/DataView backed by nonshared ArrayBuffer. Map keys/values, Set members, and record/array data properties are recursively admitted. The clone engine preserves cycles and shared references. Custom classes, including built-in subclasses, and unsupported native types are rejected. Record/array accessors are rejected without invoking getters. The canonical clone rejects functions, symbols, and similar unsupported values. Missing structuredClone is ENV_UNSUPPORTED; unsupported data is CLONE_UNSUPPORTED. The complete Utils error stays on cause, with native failure beneath it rather than skipping a layer.

Migrate older custom-class flattening, getter evaluation, cross-realm values, or unlisted built-ins to supported data, or explicitly choose diagnostic/opaque. This policy does not change Utils' own projection contract.

diagnostic prefers structuredClone and falls back to canonical recursive copying. Plain objects/arrays recurse; supported Date/RegExp/Map/Set/ArrayBuffer/TypedArray subtrees are cloned separately; function/class/host subtrees may remain shared. Enumerable accessors follow Utils' read-and-record behavior, and `__proto__` is written with defineProperty. That traversal handles cycles and shared structure; this module does not implement another clone engine. The default binding diagnostic policy cannot guarantee complete isolation. opaque avoids copying but makes no measured speed promise.

plugin-host owns Host use/unUse/dispose, installation rollback, configuration, and reverse resource cleanup. Plugin names must be unique within one Host. Disposal first closes binding-disposer admission, then calls those disposers synchronously in LIFO order, attempts each, and proceeds to plugin removal. Returned Promises are not awaited; register synchronous cleanup functions. Reentrant registration executes immediately, and late registration failures propagate synchronously through callback identity handling.

Repeated dispose returns the same Promise with `{logicalTerminal,cleanupComplete,cleanupErrors}`, preserving other plugin-host physical-cleanup information where present. Binding-disposer failures precede plugin cleanup failures in cleanupErrors; collected cleanup failures do not reject this Promise. cleanupComplete retains the plugin cleanup-completion status: physical completion does not imply an empty cleanupErrors list. Closing does not destroy the borrowed Store or Runtime. The Store remains usable without this binding observing it. Domain closures have no common open guard, so a retained runAction can still execute fn; closing plugin admission does not cancel arbitrary business callbacks.

sections.heading: Observe a Store and detach without disposing it

blocks.text: A diagnostics panel needs action and state events from an existing Store. Closing the panel must stop those observations while leaving application state usable.
Wrapping an already traced Store action in another action adds duplicate action boundaries. Treating the binding as the Store owner also makes panel cleanup destroy live state.

bindStoreMiddleware forwards the Store’s own traces and state notifications. Install store-light directly, use loggerMiddleware to collect event types, flush the Store Runtime, and dispose the binding separately.
Output:

blocks.code:
2 true 1
0 2

blocks.text: Prints `2 true 1` and `0 2`. The first action produces two action events and a state event; after binding disposal, another action changes the Store without reaching the old middleware.

Execution budgets are required; false explicitly removes each deadline. The binding borrows Store and Runtime. Its default diagnostic clone is best effort and may retain unsupported subtrees by reference.

The createStore shape contains count and an increment method, without a custom mutationPolicy. Both binding execution fields are false. Other options are omitted: the Host has an off policy, undefined actionPrefix, and diagnostic cloning. The loggerMiddleware sink collects event.type; omitting it uses console.log. Store and Runtime are borrowed; the application finally calls Store.$dispose.

sections.heading: Share one strict policy between a Store and its host

blocks.text: A component must not assign state directly, while both a Store method and a host-managed action need permission to update that same state.
Creating two actions-only policies gives each its own action depth. Entering the host policy cannot authorize writes guarded by a different Store policy.
Create one actions-only policy and pass the same object to createStore and bindStoreMiddleware. Install store-light directly; the Store enforces the guard and host.runAction enters that shared scope.
Output:

blocks.code:
ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED
true 2
3

blocks.text: Prints `ACTION_SCOPE_REQUIRED`, `true 2`, and `3`. Direct assignment is rejected, the host exposes the identical policy and can write inside its action, and the Store’s own action remains usable.

The default policy mode is off. A policy checks permission; it is not a transaction and cannot undo user side effects. Scope covers only synchronous execution, so reenter it around writes after await.

createMutationPolicy mode defaults to off; this example chooses actions-only. Store options.mutationPolicy and binding options.mutationPolicy receive the identical object. Both execution budgets are false. runAction name is diagnostic, fn writes synchronously, and metadata is undefined. Store methods enter their own action scope, while direct field writes encounter the guard.

sections.heading: Keep a diagnostic sink failure separate from a business failure

blocks.text: A logging sink fails during action observation. The application must still run its business function, while a real business exception must reach the caller.

Calling a diagnostic sink directly on the business path lets a logging outage abort the action. Swallowing every exception instead hides genuine business failure and can imply rollback that never occurred.

createStoreMiddlewareHost isolates runAction observation and reports failures to the supplied Runtime. Install reactive directly; onError collects diagnostics, while the business callback still returns or throws.
Output:

blocks.code:
42 1 2
true 2 4

blocks.text: Prints `42 1 2` and `true 2 4`. The successful business result survives two diagnostic reports; the failed action throws the same business Error and leaves its prior assignment applied.

runAction and recordState/recordError isolate observation failures; public emit can throw pipeline failures. runAction batches synchronously and does not roll back writes or wait for a returned Promise.

createRuntime.onError receives diagnostic errors; omitting it selects Runtime adapter.reportError. Host runtime and getState are required. getState returns the state reference without implicit copying. applyState is omitted and mutationPolicy defaults to off. Both execution budgets are false. The logger sink throws synchronously, while the two runAction calls return or throw a local original error.

sections.heading: Release bindings in reverse order and retain cleanup failures

blocks.text: A panel owns two binding cleanups and a plugin resource. One binding cleanup fails, but the remaining binding and plugin must still be released.
Stopping on the first cleanup exception leaves later resources behind. Independent dispose calls can also repeat cleanup unless they share one terminal operation.

Attach synchronous binding disposers to createStoreMiddlewareHost and register plugin cleanup through core.onDispose. Install reactive directly; host.dispose runs bindings in reverse order before delegated plugin cleanup.
Output:

blocks.code:
true
["second","first","plugin"]
true 1 true

blocks.text: Prints `true`, `["second","first","plugin"]`, and `true 1 true`. Calls share one disposal Promise, cleanup proceeds in the shown order, and the original failure remains in cleanupErrors.

cleanupComplete describes completed delegated cleanup, not an empty error list; settled binding failures are still recorded. Binding disposers here are synchronous; this does not claim every plugin hook is serial.

The Host receives createRuntime() and getState with both execution budgets false. attachBindingDisposer takes a synchronous no-argument function; later registrations run first. The plugin name is unique within this Host; install(core) registers cleanup with core.onDispose and returns an empty extension. dispose takes no arguments. cleanupComplete and cleanupErrors describe completion and failure separately.

sections.heading: Reenter the action scope after an await

blocks.text: An asynchronous flow starts inside an allowed action, awaits another step, then attempts a protected write. The later continuation must not inherit a permission scope that has already returned.
Keeping one global action flag open until a Promise settles authorizes unrelated work in the meantime. Treating a synchronous guard as an async transaction also hides where permission ends.

Mode defaults to off; this example chooses actions-only. runInAction returns the callback result immediately, supports nested synchronous scopes, and does not await or automatically catch later Promise rejection.

MutationPolicy mode is explicitly actions-only, defaulting to off when omitted. runInAction immediately returns fn's Promise; a later await does not preserve the synchronous scope. assertMutationAllowed operation defaults to 'mutation'; the supplied strings identify diagnostics only. insideAction is readonly state, not an externally writable permission flag.

sections.heading: Choose strict independence or explicit reference sharing

blocks.text: Audit history needs independent nested data, while diagnostics may need to keep a callback that cannot be cloned. The caller must choose which guarantee matters.
A generic fallback clone can silently return live references when history expected isolation. Calling a result immutable can also wrongly imply that the returned object is frozen.

ClonePolicy.immutable requires an independent supported data graph, opaque returns the same reference, and diagnostic copies what it can. The strict path rejects accessors without running their getters.
Output:

blocks.code:

CLONE_UNSUPPORTED 0
1 true
false

blocks.text: Prints `1 2 false true`, `CLONE_UNSUPPORTED 0`, `1 true`, and `false`. The strict copy is independent, opaque aliases, the getter is not run, and diagnostic copies nested data while retaining the callback.

Independent does not mean frozen. immutable may throw ENV_UNSUPPORTED without structuredClone or CLONE_UNSUPPORTED for rejected data; diagnostic may share unsupported subtrees, while opaque always shares the original value.

All three policies take only value, with no options. source is ordinary nested data. immutable produces an independent mutable copy, opaque preserves strict reference identity, and diagnostic copies supported data while preserving the callback. Strict admission rejects the Object.defineProperty getter with reads still zero; immutable is not a freeze operation.

This module adds mutation permission, action/state/error events, and removable diagnostic plugins to a Store. store-light owns fields, subscriptions, $plain/$hydrate; reactive owns the dependency graph and reporting; plugin-host owns installation, removal, and pipelines. Persistence and a history panel belong to store-persist and store-devtools. Store.$subscribe is enough for a simple state listener.

The root exports MutationPolicy/createMutationPolicy, event and command vocabularies, the Host/binding/logger/DevTools adapter, and errors. Clone strategies are available only from `@migaia/store-middleware/tolerant-clone`. Ordinary dependencies are middleware-pipeline, plugin-host, reactive, store-light, and utils. Explicitly install store-light/reactive when importing them directly in an example.

The old middlewarePlugin/IStoreMiddleware/IMiddlewareContext adapters were removed; use `IStoreMiddlewarePlugin`, install(core), and core.usePipeline. tolerantClone no longer exists at either entry. blocks.text: Binding captures clone(store.$plain()) as previous. A synchronous initial state-read/clone failure uses callback identity handling: uncoded failures become CALLBACK_FAILED, extensible native errors retain identity, and a frozen error remains on cause. Later subscription and Host reads keep their respective owner's error path. Each Store notification clones next, calls recordState('store:update',previous,next), then updates previous. Earlier history is not replayed: the first previous reflects binding time. Every getState clones $plain again, and applyState delegates to $hydrate.

Only ordinary fields exposed by $plain enter previous/next. Computed values, methods, WASM-backed fields, and external resources do not. Runtime action traces go straight to host.emit rather than host.runAction, avoiding a second policy scope. Wrapping the same bound Store action manually in host.runAction creates two independent event paths. actionPrefix filters names from the shared Runtime; it does not establish Store ownership.

If subscription construction fails, rollback attempts trace and state unsubscription before closing the Host. A synchronous rollback failure produces CLEANUP_FAILED AggregateError with the primary error at errors[0], followed by original cleanup errors. Cleanup does not erase the initial binding failure. Normal disposal after successful binding uses a structured result instead of this exception path.

`IDevToolsAdapter<S>` provides synchronous init(state:S) and send(event:IMiddlewareEvent<S>,state:S), plus optional subscribe(listener:(command:IDevToolsCommand<S>)=>void):IDisposer. init/send must be functions, and a supplied subscribe must also be callable; otherwise connectDevTools rejects INVALID_OPTION.

Domain commands are `{type:'commit'} | {type:'jump',state:S} | {type:'reset',state:S}`. Connection immediately calls init(core.getState()). Its event stage calls next then send, still before downstream execution. commit reinitializes current state. jump/reset use runAction('devtools:<type>',()=>applyState(state)), creating real action events. Without applyState this is DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY; a binding already bridges $hydrate. Only ordinary fields are restored, not external effects, methods, computed values, or WASM resources.

blocks.text: immutable admits a strict data graph, then delegates to Utils' sole structuredClone implementation. Supported values include ordinary/null-prototype records, ordinary arrays, current-realm native Map/Set/Date/RegExp/ArrayBuffer, and standard TypedArray/DataView backed by nonshared ArrayBuffer. Map keys/values, Set members, and record/array data properties are recursively admitted. The clone engine preserves cycles and shared references. Custom classes, including built-in subclasses, and unsupported native types are rejected. Record/array accessors are rejected without invoking getters. The canonical clone rejects functions, symbols, and similar unsupported values. Missing structuredClone is ENV_UNSUPPORTED; unsupported data is CLONE_UNSUPPORTED. The complete Utils error stays on cause, with native failure beneath it rather than skipping a layer.

Migrate older custom-class flattening, getter evaluation, cross-realm values, or unlisted built-ins to supported data, or explicitly choose diagnostic/opaque. This policy does not change Utils' own projection contract.

diagnostic prefers structuredClone and falls back to canonical recursive copying. Plain objects/arrays recurse; supported Date/RegExp/Map/Set/ArrayBuffer/TypedArray subtrees are cloned separately; function/class/host subtrees may remain shared. Enumerable accessors follow Utils' read-and-record behavior, and `__proto__` is written with defineProperty. That traversal handles cycles and shared structure; this module does not implement another clone engine. The default binding diagnostic policy cannot guarantee complete isolation. opaque avoids copying but makes no measured speed promise.

plugin-host owns Host use/unUse/dispose, installation rollback, configuration, and reverse resource cleanup. Plugin names must be unique within one Host. Disposal first closes binding-disposer admission, then calls those disposers synchronously in LIFO order, attempts each, and proceeds to plugin removal. Returned Promises are not awaited; register synchronous cleanup functions. Reentrant registration executes immediately, and late registration failures propagate synchronously through callback identity handling.

Repeated dispose returns the same Promise with `{logicalTerminal,cleanupComplete,cleanupErrors}`, preserving other plugin-host physical-cleanup information where present. Binding-disposer failures precede plugin cleanup failures in cleanupErrors; collected cleanup failures do not reject this Promise. cleanupComplete retains the plugin cleanup-completion status: physical completion does not imply an empty cleanupErrors list. Closing does not destroy the borrowed Store or Runtime. The Store remains usable without this binding observing it. Domain closures have no common open guard, so a retained runAction can still execute fn; closing plugin admission does not cancel arbitrary business callbacks.

Native errors that can accept identity keep their original object, type, message, and stack. Otherwise cause/errors retain the original value. State observation, business failure, and diagnostic failure have distinct control flow.

`createStoreMiddlewareError(code,message,options?)` returns native Error. code:IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode and message:string are required; options defaults to undefined and contains optional cause. An explicit own cause, including undefined, is forwarded to Error. `createStoreMiddlewareAggregateError(code,errors:readonly unknown[],message)` returns native AggregateError; all three arguments are required, and errors retains the original objects. Both construct without throwing automatically, attach nonwritable source/code, and leave stack intact.

plugin: Enable/disable controls: `plugin.disable(name)` hides a plugin (extensions, Features, stages) without releasing resources, `plugin.enable(name)` restores it in place, `plugin.disabled()` lists disabled names.
pipelineMode: Always sync: store event host construction overrides any supplied pipeline mode.
revision: Live revision getter from the same canonical managed host; plugin commits update it without replacing the Store domain or fluent handle identity.
config: Per-plugin configuration store. `config.get("plugin.key")` reads a frozen snapshot (unknown paths return `undefined`); `config.update(name, recipe)` merges a patch copy-on-write and commits only after the plugin `update` hook succeeds.
useSync: Installs synchronously and returns handles in input order. A declared setup immediately throws SETUP_REQUIRES_ASYNC_INSTALL. A thenable install result rejects as PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED with INSTALL_RESULT_THENABLE on cause; its later rejection is reported through the diagnostic third argument, not inserted retroactively into the immediate cause chain.
useSync.plugins: Plugin definitions with synchronous install.
The handle tuple in input order.
Building a host that must be usable right after construction.
use: Installs one or more plugins as one batch, in Feature dependency order (argument order does not matter). Either every plugin is published or the batch is rolled back in reverse order.
use.plugins: Definitions from `definePlugin()` or plugin factories such as `level()`. Names must be unique and must not contain `.`.
A Promise of the handle tuple in input order. Install failures reject with `PLUGIN_INSTALL_FAILED` (original error on `cause`, `detail.failedName`); missing providers throw `PREREQUISITE_*` directly.
Plugins with async `setup` or `install`, or plugins added at runtime.
unUse: Removes a plugin: runs its `beforeRelease`, waits for running pipelines, withdraws extensions, Features and stages, then runs its disposers and releases resources in reverse order.
unUse.name: Name of the installed plugin.
unUse.options: `policy`: what happens to plugins that require it (`reject` default, `cascade`, `suspend`); `dryRun: true` returns the plan without changing anything.
{ ok: true, affected }, or { ok: false, errors, affected } after cleanup failure or PIPELINE_DRAIN_TIMEOUT. Ordinary unUse continues bounded cleanup after a drain timeout, records/reports that failure and adds no physicalCompletion protocol. dryRun:true returns IPluginDependencyPlan.
activate: Installs a plugin that was registered with `activation: "lazy"`, first activating any lazy providers it requires. Concurrent calls share one Promise; a failure leaves it registered so it can be retried.
activate.name: Name of the lazy plugin.
The handle of the activated plugin; the original install error on failure.
Defer expensive plugins until the first request needs them.
replace: Hot-swaps a plugin: installs `next` first (the old one keeps serving if that fails), then rebinds dependents that implement `onDependencyReplaced` and restarts the others; the old generation is disposed after its running pipelines drain.
replace.name: Name of the installed plugin.
replace.next: New definition with the same name (otherwise `REPLACE_NAME_MISMATCH`).
The handle of the new generation. Old extracted extension functions throw `REGISTRATION_REVOKED`; a failed dependent restart throws `DEPENDENT_RESTART_FAILED` after the replacement took effect.
runPipeline: Runs `value` through host and plugin stages and calls `done` with the final value. Only the holder of a `defineHost()` handle can call it (subclasses use the protected method), so the domain decides when the pipeline runs.
runPipeline.value: Input value.
runPipeline.done: Final callback; not called when a stage stops the value.
`void` in sync modes, a Promise in async modes; host disposal aborts the run with `HOST_DISPOSING`.
dispose: Stops host admission, runs binding disposers in reverse order, then delegates plugin lifecycle cleanup. Every disposer is attempted and binding errors precede plugin errors.
Shared Promise<IPluginHostDisposalResult> with logicalTerminal, cleanupComplete and cleanupErrors. Binding throws are reported in this result; unfinished physical cleanup remains reachable through physicalCompletion.
usePipeline: Adds a synchronous processing function to the host pipeline. Receive the current value and call next(newValue) to continue with a value for the next function. Omitting next() stops processing. The host adapts this synchronous function to its selected mode, so this registration method works in every host mode.
usePipeline.stage: Sync stage; call `next(value)` to continue, omit it to stop the value.
The host itself, so calls can be chained.
useAsyncPipeline: Registers a step that can await other work before or after the next event-processing step. This requires async mode. Store event hosts process events synchronously, so this call throws PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH, meaning the requested step does not match the host mode. Use usePipeline for synchronous steps.
useAsyncPipeline.stage: `async (value, next) => { await next(value) }`; code after `await next()` runs after downstream.
The host itself.
useGeneratorPipeline: Registers a generator function that uses yield to supply a processed value. That form runs only in generator or async-generator mode. On a Store event host, registration throws PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH because its event pipeline accepts synchronous next-style steps only. To transform an event here, register usePipeline and pass the resulting event to next before the callback returns.
useGeneratorPipeline.stage: `function* (value)`; return a value or a `GENERATOR_*` signal.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline: Registers a function that combines awaited work with values supplied through yield. Only async-generator mode can execute that combination. Store event hosts cannot await yielded results, so this registration fails with PIPELINE_MODE_MISMATCH, the error for an incompatible step mode. Complete asynchronous preparation before emitting the store event, then use usePipeline for the remaining synchronous handling.
useAsyncGeneratorPipeline.stage: `async function* (value)`; drained completely before the next stage.
mutationPolicy: Exact caller policy object or a newly created off policy; share the same policy with the Store when enforcing actions-only writes.
emit: Synchronously runs an event through the host pipeline. Missing continuation reports MIDDLEWARE_NOT_CHAINED; other pipeline failures may propagate from this public method.
emit.event: IMiddlewareEvent from host domain methods, Store trace binding or explicit caller construction using the event constants.
No result after synchronous delivery; this is the direct emission boundary rather than isolated business-action observation.
runAction: Emits isolated start, runs fn inside mutation policy and Runtime batch, then emits isolated end or error. Synchronous business failures retain native identity or remain reachable through cause/errors under the policy callback contract; observer failures are reported.
runAction.name: Application-selected action label propagated to all three action phases.
runAction.fn: Synchronous no-argument business callback; return T or throw. Promises are returned without awaiting, so async continuations and rejections are outside action scope.
runAction.metadata: Optional caller diagnostic record; defaults to absent and retains its reference.
Exact fn return or policy-classified synchronous failure; foreign Reactive/pipeline errors keep their package identity. Action duration covers synchronous execution only.
recordState: Emits an isolated state observation without changing Store state. Middleware failures are reported rather than reaching the business caller.
recordState.name: Application-selected state observation label.
recordState.previous: Previous snapshot owned by the caller or binding clone policy.
recordState.next: Next snapshot owned by the caller or binding clone policy.
recordState.metadata: Optional diagnostic record, absent by default and retained by reference.
No result after isolated observation; state application is a separate capability.
recordError: Emits one isolated diagnostic-error event. Reentrant calls while handling an error report directly to Runtime without starting another middleware pipeline.
recordError.phase: Caller diagnostic phase identifying the failed subsystem or operation.
recordError.error: Original diagnostic failure value retained by identity.
recordError.metadata: Optional caller metadata; defaults to absent and is not cloned.
No result; observation failures are routed to Runtime.
connectDevTools: Installs a plugin that initializes an adapter, sends events after recording sync continuation and before downstream execution and subscribes to normalized commands. Pair with createReduxDevToolsAdapter when using a Redux extension-shaped connection.
connectDevTools.adapter: IDevToolsAdapter from createReduxDevToolsAdapter or caller implementation; init/send are required and subscribe is optional.
connectDevTools.name: Optional unique plugin name chosen by the application; defaults to store-devtools.
Promise<void> after plugin installation. Invalid adapter uses INVALID_OPTION; install failures retain plugin-host semantics; jump/reset without applyState uses DEVTOOLS_CAPABILITY.
attachBindingDisposer: While open, registers synchronous cleanup in reverse order before delegated plugin-host disposal. Once closing starts, registration invokes the disposer immediately; a synchronous failure propagates with CALLBACK_FAILED identity or preserves its foreign owner.
attachBindingDisposer.disposer: Caller-owned IDisposer accepting no arguments and returning nothing; throws are collected into structured disposal cleanupErrors.
No result; an open host retains cleanup until disposal, while a closing host finishes it before this call returns.

import { createStore } from '@migaia/store-light'
import { bindStoreMiddleware, loggerMiddleware } from '@migaia/store-middleware'

const events: string[] = []
const store = createStore({ count: 0 })
const execution = { mutationTimeoutMs: false, pipelineDrainTimeoutMs: false } as const
const host = bindStoreMiddleware(store, { execution })
await host.use(loggerMiddleware((event) => events.push(event.type)))
store.count = 1
store.$runtime.flush()
console.log(events.join(','))
await host.dispose()
store.count = 2
console.log(store.count)
await store.$dispose()

blocks.text: Host 的 use/unUse/dispose、插件失败回滚、配置与资源逆序清理归 plugin-host。同一 Host 插件名唯一。dispose 首先关闭 binding disposer 登记，再同步按后进先出调用，尝试全部清理，之后卸载插件；不等待 disposer 返回的 Promise，应登记同步函数。重入登记立即执行；晚登记失败按 callback 身份规则同步传播。

重复 dispose 返回同一 Promise，结果为 `{logicalTerminal,cleanupComplete,cleanupErrors}`，可保留 plugin-host 的其它物理清理信息。绑定 disposer 失败排在 cleanupErrors 前面，然后是插件清理失败；这些被收集而不以清理异常拒绝 Promise。cleanupComplete 沿用插件清理完成状态，表示物理完成，不表示 cleanupErrors 必为空。关闭不会销毁借入 Store/Runtime；Store 可继续工作，只是不再被这一绑定观察。领域闭包没有统一的 open 守卫，保留的 runAction 仍可执行 fn；关闭插件接纳不等于取消任意业务回调。

blocks.text: Host 的 use/unUse/dispose、插件失败回滚、配置与资源逆序清理归 plugin-host。同一 Host 插件名唯一。dispose 首先关闭 binding disposer 登记，再同步按后进先出调用，尝试全部清理，之后卸载插件；不等待 disposer 返回的 Promise，应登记同步函数。重入登记立即执行；晚登记失败按 callback 身份规则同步传播。

重复 dispose 返回同一 Promise，结果为 `{logicalTerminal,cleanupComplete,cleanupErrors}`，可保留 plugin-host 的其它物理清理信息。绑定 disposer 失败排在 cleanupErrors 前面，然后是插件清理失败；这些被收集而不以清理异常拒绝 Promise。cleanupComplete 沿用插件清理完成状态，表示物理完成，不表示 cleanupErrors 必为空。关闭不会销毁借入 Store/Runtime；Store 可继续工作，只是不再被这一绑定观察。领域闭包没有统一的 open 守卫，保留的 runAction 仍可执行 fn；关闭插件接纳不等于取消任意业务回调。

blocks.text: `IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode` 是码值联合，`STORE_MIDDLEWARE_SOURCE='@migaia/store-middleware'` 只标识本包创建的错误；Reactive、pipeline 及其它已有 source/code 保持实际 owner。能附码的原生错误保留原实例、类型、message、stack，不可附码或非 Error 值经 cause/errors 保留。不要把记录状态、业务失败与诊断失败混成一个控制流。

`createStoreMiddlewareError(code,message,options?)` 返回原生 Error；code:IStoreMiddlewareErrorCode、message:string 均必填，options 默认 undefined，唯一字段可选 cause；显式自有 cause（包括 undefined）转发原生 Error。`createStoreMiddlewareAggregateError(code,errors:readonly unknown[],message)` 返回原生 AggregateError，三参必填，errors 保留原对象。两者只构造、不自动 throw，附不可写 source/code、不改 stack。
